full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white etching shows a busy turn-of-the-century seafront street viewed from slightly above. Multiple tram rails start at the bottom edge and sweep in broad curves toward the middle distance, guiding the eye through an open paved foreground. Horse-drawn carriages and early vehicles occupy the center and left, while small dark pedestrians cross among them. Tall narrow lamp posts punctuate the route; a tram or streetcar is partly visible at the right edge. Beyond the moving street, a long low pier stretches over pale water. A large Ferris wheel rises near the upper center-right, its skeletal circular structure faint against a light sky. Farther left, layers of broad buildings, pointed roofs, and a slender mast or spire dissolve into gray haze. The scene is intricate without being uniformly dark. Foreground figures and wheels are made from dense black crosshatching and sharp contour cuts, while distant structures are drawn with sparse lighter strokes, allowing the paper to show through. The street surface is nearly white in places, crossed by tram lines, short diagonal shadows, and scratched marks that imply damp or worn paving. A shallow horizon and open sky give breathing space above the dense middle band. The monochrome palette ranges from warm paper white to soft gray and inky black, with no color accents. Light is diffuse overcast daylight from the pale sky, so there are few strong cast shadows; depth comes instead from line density and atmospheric fading. The composition feels lively and historical, balancing a detailed street crowd with clear sweeping rails and the distant round wheel as a final visual landmark.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白蚀刻版画从略高视点描绘世纪之交繁忙的海滨街道。数条电车轨从下缘起步，以宽弧扫向中远处，带视线穿过开放铺石前景。马车与早期车辆占据中央和左侧，小小深色行人在它们之间穿行。高而细的路灯杆沿路点出节奏；右边缘部分露出一辆电车。运动街道后方，长而低的栈桥伸过浅色水面。一座大摩天轮在上方偏右处升起，骨架般圆形结构在浅天空前显得淡。更左处，宽楼群、尖屋顶和一根细桅杆或塔尖层叠在灰雾中。场景繁密，却并非处处同样黑。前景人物和车轮由密集黑色交叉排线与锐利刻痕组成，远建筑则由更稀、更浅的线绘出，让纸面透出。街面局部几乎白色，被电车线、短斜影与刮擦痕交叉，暗示潮湿或磨损的铺地。低地平与开放天空为密集中带上方提供呼吸空间。单色配色从暖纸白到柔灰与墨黑，没有彩色点缀。光来自浅天空的漫射阴天日光，因此强投影不多；纵深更多由线密度和空气退淡形成。构图热闹且有年代感，用清楚横扫的轨道和远方圆轮这一最终视觉标记平衡细密街道人群。
style_prompt_en: A black-ink etching treatment on warm pale paper organizes a complex scene through graded line density. Dark foreground clusters use tight crosshatching, jagged contour cuts, and concentrated black accents, while distant layers are built from sparse, fading strokes. Several long curved lines begin at the lower edge and sweep inward, creating a clean directional path through a largely open light plane. A faint large circular framework rises above a densely marked middle strip and is countered by thin vertical ticks. The upper field retains substantial paper white and light gray haze. Scratched diagonal marks enliven the lower surface without filling it uniformly. Illumination is diffuse and low-contrast in the distance; stronger near contrast comes from ink coverage, not dramatic spotlighting. The print is tactile and slightly irregular, with a busy historical cadence that remains readable because broad light spaces separate its darkest marks.
style_prompt_zh: 暖浅纸上的黑墨蚀刻处理通过分级线密度组织复杂场景。深暗前景簇群使用紧密交叉排线、参差轮廓刻痕和集中的黑色点缀，远方层次则由稀疏、逐渐退淡的笔痕建立。数条长弯线从下缘起步向内扫去，在大体开放的浅色平面中制造干净方向路径。一个淡而大的圆形骨架升在笔痕密集的中带上方，由细竖线标记对拍。上部色域保留大量纸白和浅灰雾。刮擦斜线活跃下部表面，却不把它均匀填满。远方照明漫射且低对比；近处更强的对比来自油墨覆盖率，而非戏剧聚光。印刷有触感且略不规则，繁忙的年代节奏仍可读，因为宽浅空间分开最深暗笔痕。
theme_en: A busy turn-of-the-century seafront with curved tram tracks, carriages and a distant wheel
theme_zh: 世纪之交繁忙海滨街道，弯曲电车轨、马车与远方摩天轮
name: Joseph Pennell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
